Dear Amin,

Thank you for your patience as we worked out the logistics for our upcoming study. It took a bit longer than expected, but we have now finalized our plan. We are proposing to conduct a small pilot study in January or February 2025, with a sample of 10 participants, followed by the full data collection in September 2025.

Thank you!

Best wishes

subject: Fwd: call update
body:
Dear Luisa and Laura,

I hope you are doing well.

This is Sara from Avicenna Research. It was a pleasure speaking with you, and I’m excited about the opportunity to collaborate on your project.

As we discussed, we are pleased to offer the pilot phase at no cost. You can sign up as a researcher here, where you can create your study and set up your protocol at your convenience. Once you’ve completed that, simply share your study ID with me, and we can upgrade it to the full license. If you need any help along the way, feel free to reach out to me or the support team. Additionally, you can check out our documentation website here.

I will also coordinate with the team to issue the invoice for the main phase and will send it to you soon to ensure we are all set.

Regarding the gamification feature, we would need a bit more information to integrate it into your study. We can discuss this further once your study design is complete.

If you have any questions in the meantime, please don't hesitate to reach out. We are here to assist you through every step of this process.

Have a great weekend.
Best,
Sara
